description: Bounded CPU direct-sampling utility-tilt config for the PI demonstration (artifacts/pi_demo/). Larger than the 1-epoch fixture-smoke config (configs/density_lab/utility_tilt/d9_fixture_smoke_v0.json) but still sized for a laptop-class CPU, no GPU: ~12k train rows per PDG track, max_epochs bounded, early stopping on. This is a bounded CPU-scale flow for demonstrating that the direct-sampling tilt mechanism trains and produces samples consistent with the declared target -- it is not a converged production model and makes no claim of physical accuracy.
